PLAN "Cycle-Phased Strength Programme"
TYPE workout
VISIBILITY public

GOALS
  GOAL primary strength:
    name "Progress strength around menstrual cycle"

PHASES
  PHASE "Block 1 - Foundation" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Monday training 50m "Lower Strength - Flow Day":
        warmup:
          walking 8m
        main straight_sets:
          goblet_squat 3x10 rpe 5 rest 90 seconds
          glute_bridge 3x12 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
          leg_curl 3x12 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
          dead_bug 3x10 rpe 5 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          child_pose 2m
          pigeon_pose 3m
          diaphragmatic_breathing 3m
      DAY Wednesday training 45m "Upper Mobility - Flow Day":
        warmup:
          walking 6m
        main straight_sets:
          dumbbell_press 3x10 rpe 5 rest 75 seconds
          cable_row 3x10 rpe 5 rest 75 seconds
          lateral_raise 3x12 rpe 5 rest 45 seconds
          face_pull 3x12 rpe 5 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          chest_stretch 2m
          lat_stretch 2m
          diaphragmatic_breathing 3m
      DAY Friday training 50m "Full Body - Post Flow":
        warmup:
          cycling 6m
          leg_swings 2m
        main straight_sets:
          squat 4x8 rpe 7 rest 120 seconds
          bench_press 4x8 rpe 7 rest 120 seconds
          romanian_deadlift 3x10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          dumbbell_row 3x10 rpe 7 rest 75 seconds
          plank 3x45 rpe 6 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          hamstring_stretch 2m
          hip_flexor_stretch 2m
    WEEK 2:
